title: koeleria cristata subsp. glauca
intro: Koeleria cristata subsp. glauca, commonly known as June grass, is a type of perennial grass that belongs to the Poaceae family. June grass has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, making it a potential treatment for various health conditions such as digestive issues and respiratory problems. The therapeutic actions of June grass are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which have been shown to exhibit anti-inflammatory and antioxidant activities. However, further research is needed to fully understand the effects and optimal uses of June grass.
